verdict.rationale: Fastmail publishes JMAP, an open, documented API protocol with a discoverable session endpoint, standard OAuth2/Bearer auth, API tokens, push via EventSource/WebPush, and a dedicated dev docs page (fastmail.com/dev), giving AI-native users a clear, standards-based way to programmatically drive the product. Missing for 10: no evidence of an OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
